answer: Entry to the task market costs 5 work slots locked at 0.02 SOL each; each honest task burns 0.005 SOL of the deposit and releases the rest — blocking sybil swarms farming fake identities. A 1,000-fake-agent attacker burns 1,000 x 0.005 = 5 SOL for nothing, while an honest agent pays only 0.005 SOL per real task. A grove grows from sown seeds; each burn glows violet on the ledger, and the echo of completed work buys reputation and higher payouts.
